spec.description: This metric is always emitted. If it's not, it means the process stopped.
spec.title: Block Number

spec.description: Positive numbers represent we would profit and are quoting as expected. Negative numbers represent bad fills. This should only happen in rare edge cases.
spec.title: Price Delta % of Arbitrage

spec.description: Each tick represents 1bp in the Chainflip pool.
spec.title: Price and Quotes (tick)

spec.description: The spreads we quote *compared* to Chainflip prices.
spec.title: Order Spreads

spec.description: These are the balances in multiple coins. For now, this does not take into account accumulated fee incentives for the order fills. Gas fees are also tracked in another panel.
spec.title: Balances (USD)

spec.query:
SELECT sum("fee_pnl_usd") / 0.0010
FROM "default_defi_retention"."chainflip_prod_hedging"
WHERE ("pool"::tag ='eth')
GROUP BY time(24h) fill(0)

SELECT sum("fee_pnl_usd") / 0.0015
FROM "default_defi_retention"."chainflip_prod_hedging"
WHERE ("pool"::tag ='btc') 
GROUP BY time(24h) fill(0)

SELECT sum("fee_pnl_usd") / 0.0010
FROM "default_defi_retention"."chainflip_prod_hedging"
WHERE ("pool"::tag ='dot') 
GROUP BY time(24h) fill(0)

spec.description: This balance represents the FLIP amount for paying gas fees.
spec.title: Flip Balance (gas fees)

spec.query: SELECT last("spread_within_200_bps") FROM "default_defi_retention"."chainflip_prod_hedging" WHERE ("pool"::tag =~ /^$Pool$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

SELECT median("whole_tokens_balance") FROM "default_defi_retention"."chainflip_prod_hedging" WHERE ("pool"::tag =~ /^$Pool$/ AND "symbol"::tag =~ /^$Pool$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(previous)

SELECT last("positionAsFloat") 
FROM "default_signals_retention"."StrategySignal" 
WHERE ('eth' =~ /^$Pool$/ AND "strategy"::tag = 'ARB_V2_DEFI_CHAINFLIP_ETH_BDM_USDT_Q|H') OR ('btc' =~ /^$Pool$/ AND "strategy"::tag = 'ARB_V2_DEFI_CHAINFLIP_BTC_BDM_USDT_Q|H') OR ('dot' =~ /^$Pool$/ AND "strategy"::tag = 'ARB_V2_DEFI_CHAINFLIP_DOT_BDM_USDT_Q|H')
AND $timeFilter 
GROUP BY time($__interval) 
fill(previous)

SELECT last("order_amount") FROM "default_defi_retention"."chainflip_prod_hedging" WHERE ("pool"::tag =~ /^$Pool$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "order_id"::tag, "is_buy"::tag fill(null)

spec.description:
Configured to be between a small range (e.g. 11K-12.5K) and most of the time they should be at the higher end. 

While not too useful right now, in the future, if a 2-layer solution is implemented, this panel would be pretty useful.
spec.title: Order Quote Amounts (USD)

spec.query: SELECT last("pnl") FROM "default"."acct_lvl_daily_pnl" WHERE (('eth' =~ /^$Pool$/ AND "label" =~ /^DEFI--CHAINFLIP--ETH$/ AND "level" =~ /^(0|1|2|3|4)$/ AND "label"::tag != 'SLN--DEFI') OR ('btc' =~ /^$Pool$/ AND "label" =~ /^DEFI--CHAINFLIP--BTC$/ AND "level" =~ /^(0|1|2|3|4)$/ AND "label"::tag != 'SLN--DEFI') OR ('dot' =~ /^$Pool$/ AND "label" =~ /^DEFI--CHAINFLIP--DOT$/ AND "level" =~ /^(0|1|2|3|4)$/ AND "label"::tag != 'SLN--DEFI')) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "label", "level" fill(none)

SELECT median("price_pnl_usd") AS "arbitrage_pnl_usd" FROM "default_defi_retention"."chainflip_prod_hedging" WHERE ("pool"::tag =~ /^$Pool$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "order_id"::tag fill(null)

SELECT median("fee_pnl_usd") AS fee_pnl_usd FROM "default_defi_retention"."chainflip_prod_hedging" WHERE ("pool"::tag =~ /^$Pool$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "order_id"::tag fill(null)

SELECT mean("total_pnl_usd") AS "theoretical_total_pnl"  FROM  "default_defi_retention"."chainflip_prod_hedging" WHERE ("pool"::tag =~ /^$Pool$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "order_id"::tag fill(null)
